reason: The person asked why the agent kept saying an agent "seems stuck". The answer needed tracing through attention.js, walk.js RESTLESS and the dispatch signal list. No skill records that mapping, and the CLI JSON pitfall cost several tool calls.

A 'seems stuck' alert fired on a rotation agent that was mid browser test; dispatch_peers showed it working and the orchestrator had to investigate before it could tell the person it was fine. The alert's trigger needs an explicit false-positive note.
Absorbed into metaform-ticket-dispatch as its stuck-or-spinning alerts section.
